All four exact experiment containers are exited, no owned evaluator/controller/profiler process remains, and the non-volatile final evidence audit passed with zero errors.
failed_or_open_gates: The observed throughput and duration gains are about one percent and do not reproduce the magnitude of the prior Qwen3.5/TP2/Hypic-only result.
Full coexistence verification is false because mixed_decode_latency_protection and mixed_decode_grouped_reclaim signals are missing.
Exact baseline-treatment output hashes differ, while baseline repeat nondeterminism prevents attributing the mismatch solely to Hypic.

PDC baseline and PDC+Hypic LongBench-v2 and GSM8K three-run evidence are complete with zero request failures. The treatment GSM8K mean delta is within baseline repeated-run range, but its run3 matching delta is -0.682335pp and treatment range exceeds baseline range, so an accuracy-lossless claim is not authorized.
NIAH+ is blocked because the authoritative NeedleBench data files are absent.
Both native profiles are complete, but the treatment capture itself confirms incomplete coexistence rather than resolving it.
Paper C3 distributed scatter/transfer is not implemented in this single-instance test.
interim_rule: Final fail-closed rule: do not claim deployable, accuracy-lossless, paper-complete, or equal to the prior result for this configuration.
next_gate: None for the current configuration. Reopen only for a materially different implementation that restores every coexistence signal, adds authoritative NIAH+ evidence, and repeats the frozen A/B ruler.
final_rationale: Reject adoption: TTFT improved materially, but throughput and duration improved only about one percent, TPOT was flat, full coexistence and paper C3 are absent, and the available repeated quality evidence does not establish losslessness.
